model.architecture_family: decoder-only Transformer (dense, Llama 3 architecture, unchanged by conversion)
model.intended_use: MLX-format repackaging of Llama 3.1 8B Instruct (BF16 weights) for local inference on Apple silicon via mlx-lm; same general-assistant / instruction-following use case as the source model.
limitations: inherits all base-model limitations and biases (no new training)
no independent safety evaluation of the converted artifact
requires mlx-lm / Apple silicon runtime to load

provenance.notes: The mlx-community card states this repo was converted to MLX format from meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using mlx-lm version 0.19.0. Weights are kept at BF16 precision; no additional training, fine-tuning, or dataset use is reported. Repo created 2024-07-23, same day as the Llama 3.1 release.

transformation.objective: Repackage the BF16 safetensors weights of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct into Apple's MLX array/model format so the model can be loaded and run locally with mlx-lm on Apple silicon.
transformation.notes: Conversion tool: mlx-lm 0.19.0 (per model card). No training data was used; this is a lossless-precision format/runtime conversion (BF16 -> BF16 MLX arrays), not a quantization or fine-tune. Exact conversion command/flags and numerical-equivalence tests are not published.

safety.risk_level: Inherited from Llama 3.1 8B Instruct; the MLX conversion reports no independent safety evaluation or new risk-mitigation work.

items.description: Use is governed by the Llama 3.1 Acceptable Use Policy (inherited from the source model), which prohibits illegal activity, weapons/CBRNE development, generation of CSAM, disinformation, unauthorized professional advice, and other harmful uses.

As a format conversion, this artifact carries the same general LLM risks as the source model (hallucination, bias, unsafe or inaccurate outputs) with no additional mitigation applied during conversion.

licenses.name: Llama 3.1 Community License
restrictions: >700M MAU requires a separate license from Meta

must comply with the Llama 3.1 Acceptable Use Policy
licenses.scope_note: Inherited from the source model meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct; the mlx-community card's HF metadata declares license 'llama3.1' and no separate license is issued for the MLX conversion.
